plainText:
Emma (Japanese: マチエール Matiere) is a character that appeared in , debuting within the three-special episodes of Episode: Mega Evolution.

== History ==
=== Pre-series ===
Emma grew up in the streets of Lumiose City and never knew either of her parents. One day, she met a man named Looker, who took her in and taught her how to read and write. Eventually, Looker left Lumiose City and allowed Emma to keep living in the building in which he owned. At some point, Emma met a young boy named Ult who, much like herself, lived in the streets of Lumiose City and she kindly decided to invite him to live with her, while also teaching him how to read and write, just as Looker had done for herself.

=== Episode: Mega Evolution ===
Emma first appeared in Mega Evolution - Ult, where she hosted Ult and his friend Roy at her home, cooking them a feast and kindly encouraging Roy to enjoy it as much as he can. After Ult left to challenge the Yellow Blast, Emma shared his past with Roy and asked him to become friends with Ult, noticing that he's never cared about anyone as much as he did currently, which Roy gladly complied.

In Mega Evolution - Bonds, Emma said goodbye to Ult and Roy, and during the farewell with Ult, she wished him a good trip and that he will always have a home with her, and that he is like family to her. With Roy, Emma thanked him for everything he did for Ult and then used Mimi to sense Captain Pikachu's feelings for Roy and highlighted how much Roy was becoming like Friede. Some time later, Emma and Mimi found Roy's hat and placed it next to a picture of her with her Pokémon, as well as Roy and Ult.

== Character ==
Emma is a good-natured young girl, allowing Ult to live with her and teaching him how to read and write, and finding his sharp-tongued demeanor quite amusing. She's also a good hostess, going to great lengths to make Roy feel welcomed at her home and even pushing herself a little too hard to serve him and Ult during dinner. Emma is also quite a klutz, almost dropping all of her plates (with the food still on) because of the heavy weight she was carrying. She's also quite forgetful, forgetting to mention to Roy that she dreamed of becoming a detective, so much so that her forgetful nature reminded Captain Pikachu of Friede.
